name: Utsukushiki Elf ~Seinaru Yoru~
original_name: 美しきエルフ ～聖なる夜～
source:
The Holy Night, a special day once a year spent with loved ones.
The town buzzed with excitement every day leading up to the Holy Night.

The elf girl Sia, who had never experienced the Holy Night before, was told by the human doctor Fritz, "I want you to spend this year's Holy Night having fun with Matthias and Lydi."

But then Fritz says he'll be too busy with work to meet up with Sia that day...

A heartwarming, gentle love story themed around Christmas. 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13339]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
圣夜，一年一次与亲人共度的特殊日子。
圣夜前夕，小镇每天都热闹非凡。

从未经历过圣夜的精灵少女西亚，被人类医生弗里茨告知：“我希望你能和马蒂亚斯和莉迪一起度过今年的圣夜。”

但弗里茨说他那天工作太忙而无法与希亚见面……

以圣诞节为主题的温馨、温柔的爱情故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13339]Novelgame[/url]]
